description.value: The Moose Pub & Liquor Store is a neighbourhood pub established in 1993 in Valemount, a small mountain community along the Yellowhead corridor in BC. It caters to locals and travellers alike — the website specifically calls out cyclists visiting the Valemount mountain bike park as a core clientele. The pub serves food and drinks with views of the Rockies and accepts table reservations for groups up to 20.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at themoosepubvalemount.com confirms an active pub and liquor store at 1485 5th Ave, Valemount, BC, with food, drinks, and Rocky Mountain views, established 1993. The OSM name 'The Moose Pub & Bistro' diverges from the website's consistent branding of 'The Moose Pub & Liquor Store' across all pages — flagged as a concern. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are explicitly mentioned on the website, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM name is 'The Moose Pub & Bistro' but the website consistently uses 'The Moose Pub & Liquor Store' across all pages — OSM name may be outdated or incorrect.
Minor email discrepancy: front page uses MAIL@MOOSEPUB.COM while the /location subpage uses MAIL@MOOSEPUB.CA.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pub and liquor store in Valemount actively serving cyclists visiting the local mountain bike park — a useful stop for touring cyclists on the Yellowhead route.
